MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK
  INTERNATIONAL FRIENDSHIP COMMISSION
  January 13, 2026

Vice Chair Gomez called the meeting to order at 5:10 p.m. in Conference Room 4,
Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard, Norwalk, California. Responding to roll call
were Commissioner Flores and Commissioner Salas. Also, present were Ozzie Ramos,
Deputy City Manager, Amber Bulosan, Management Analyst, and Svetlana Hernandez,
Office Assistant I.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Flores motioned for the approval of the minutes of the International
Friendship Commission Regular Meeting minutes that was held on December 8, 2025.
Commissioner Gomez seconded the motion.

MOTION CARRIED BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Commissioner Flores, Commissioner Gomez, Commissioner Salas
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None
ABSTAIN:  None

REPORTS

Strategic Planning

The Commission communicated ideas and strategies in furthering the Commission’s
Vision and Mission statement.

STAFF COMMENTS

No Staff comment

COMMISSIONER COMMENTS

No Commissioner comment

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

No public comment
 ADJOURNMENT:

Being no further business to come before the International Friendship Commission, the
meeting was adjourned at 5:38 p.m.

_______________________________
CHAIR
Maria Carbajal
